MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.

3. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

4. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

5. When practising Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.

6. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
